items.title: Allstate (ALL) Reports Q2 Earnings: What Key Metrics Have to Say
items.summary: While the top- and bottom-line numbers for Allstate (ALL) give a sense of how the business performed in the quarter ended June 2026, it could be worth looking at how some of its key metrics compare to Wall Street estimates and year-ago values.

items.title: Allstate (ALL) Beats Q2 Earnings Estimates
items.summary: Allstate (ALL) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +56.08% and -1.05%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Allstate (NYSE:ALL) Reports Bullish Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Insurance giant Allstate (NYSE:ALL) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 10.8% year on year to $18.6 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $8.99 per share was 48% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: 1 Profitable Stock with Exciting Potential and 2 Facing Headwinds
items.summary: Even if a company is profitable, it doesn’t always mean it’s a great investment. Some struggle to maintain growth, face looming threats, or fail to reinvest wisely, limiting their future potential.

items.title: What Allstate (ALL)'s Mixed Earnings Outlook and Stronger Premium, Investment Income Trends Mean For Shareholders
items.summary: In the lead-up to Allstate's recent earnings release, investors focused on forecasts calling for lower quarterly earnings than a year earlier alongside higher revenue, with analysts expecting growth in Property-Liability Net Investment Income, Net Premiums Earned, and shifts in auto and homeowners loss and combined ratios. This mix of softer earnings and stronger top-line drivers, tied to underlying insurance profitability metrics, has sharpened attention on how Allstate is managing claims...
